source_name: President Paul Kagame official speech archive paulkagame.com (Wayback/CDX)
notes: Probe-validated 2026-07-27 (--spread --n 8): 7,666 host captures -> 3,463 kept. GREENFIELD (no live Rwanda recipe). TWO site generations both harvested: WordPress flat single-segment posts (2021-2025 crawls of content back to ~2009) and the older Joomla /index.php/speeches[/<category>]/<id>-<slug> tree. TITLE(h1 on WP; <title> on Joomla, which has no h1) and DATE(div.post-date) green on all samples, dates 2010-2023; TEXT(article) 928-3,859 chars with recipe length ~= generic length, confirming <article> is the right container. WHY NOT presidency.gov.rw: only ~64 status-200 /speeches/ captures, many truncated slugs, and its content is a subset of the same Joomla archive - it would mostly add duplicates. TWO CAVEATS THE RESEARCHER SHOULD WEIGH. (1) YIELD: about ONE IN FOUR kept URLs is a VIDEO-ONLY post with no transcript - <article> holds ~15 chars and even the generic extractor finds only ~570 chars of chrome (2 of 8 sampled, both with the '<Event> | Kigali, <date>' title form). They will be rejected by the cleaner's gate, so budget the real speech yield at roughly 2,600, not 3,463. (2) LANGUAGE: 81 of the 3,571 pre-filter URLs (2.3%) are KINYARWANDA (slugs carrying 'ijambo'/'nyakubahwa'/'perezida-wa-repubulika'). Because the recipe declares source_language English, map_to_schema would route those bodies into the ENGLISH text column - the same data-quality bug found on geo_president_wayback - so a negative lookahead now excludes them (108 URLs dropped). Slug matching only catches the obvious ones; the cleaner's language pass is the backstop, and a companion rwa_kagame_kinyarwanda_wayback (source_language Kinyarwanda -> translation stage) could harvest them properly, the way afg_aop_english/afg_aop_dari are split. NO speaker_default: although this is Kagame's own site it also carries third-person news and occasional guest speakers. FULL RUN is the researcher's gate.
